reviews.title: THEE worst sportsbook to currently exist. Just go for MGM or Caesars if you live in Nevada.
reviews.text:
There are many pros and cons to William Hill but mostly cons if I’m being honest. William Hill is owned by Caesars AND Caesars sportsbook does not charge a fee for deposits in the app while William Hill does!? Over time, all that money adds up. Anyways, I’ve been pretty much betting almost everyday for about 2 years. Here’s what I’ve learned.

Pros- Props (players specifically) are up early the day before.
- Player props listed that other sport books tend to “hide” or simply not put up, even minutes before the game.
-Odds tend to be fair or have a slight advantage compared to others (Which you could get the same thing for Caesars anyways). 

CONS- Cashouts are AHHH. Cashouts rarely get offered depending on the sport but for the most part….Cashouts stay unavailable. Hypothetically, you could have a 4 leg parlay and say it’s 3/4. You need one more to win. Other books tend to offer you a cashout before the game right but this app RARELY does and it’s so annoying. Mainly, they won’t give you a cashout at all from my experience. So you tend to find ways to hedge your bet to find profit. Or you just gotta be lucky for your last leg to hit. 

- Mid-game props (they stay locked). It’s like they know what to lock you from so you can’t win. 

- Support. I accidentally placed a bet and tried contacting support.
TO NAVIGATE AND ACTUALLY TALK TO SOMEONE INSTEAD OF A BOT IS SO FRUSTRATING. Like let me talk to someone Jesus. Once I finally figured out by faking I had trouble depositing, I spoke to someone. I told him/her “I accidentally placed a bet I didn’t mean to, I was checking to see how much it would pay” 
Keep in mind, I contacted support RIGHT AWAY after the mishap.
Then he had me wait for 10 minutes and verify my account, just to tell me “I can’t void/refund you the accidental bet you placed. You’re gonna have to either cash out the current offer ($-10 loss if I accepted it) or just ride it out”

??????? LIKE HELLO? That was the first ever hearing support tell me they can’t refund my accidental bet. For added context, the selected game was for (Tomorrow). So it’s not like it was live or minutes before. Horrible support. Luckily my bet won. 

-Deposit fee. Like why does this exist? Literally just a bail for William Hill to stay profitable. MGM and Caesars don’t have a deposit fee. Kinda weird how Caesars owns William Hill and somehow William Hill have a deposit fee

-Benefits
Literally no benefits at all. Besides the little profits boosts they give you. Other than that, it just sucks. 

I only used this sports book because of how early they release player props etc. I just don’t trust this book to give you fair cashouts and the fee sucks every time. If only Vegas had FanDuel. Smh. 
You’re better off using Caesars or MGM imo.

If you are reading this, trust me when I say THIS IS NOT A 5 STAR SPORTSBOOK. I’m looking at reviews and I’m seeing a post rated 5 stars but the dude is explaining how terrible it is. HELLO????
Watch William Hill try and hide at the one star reviews just to stay relevant. It’s rated 2.5 at most tbh.
